svg.text: Only the car's signature lines remain. The rest is empty: the wall and the light do the drawing
A · Line-cut plate (CNC / laser / printed), backlit
B · String art on a wood board (nails + thread)
C · Two thin line layers 5 mm apart (depth + shadow)
• Recognizable from lines alone: roofline, beltline, arches, light signature
• Thin = fast print, low material cost (A3 ≈ 2–3 mm plate)
• Backlit (LED strip behind) → glows at night, 'wow' effect
• Same file: print on H2D, or send to CNC/laser for wood/acrylic
• Custom: customer's car → lines traced from a photo
